The 0.9 V input common mode forces an NMOS input pair because PMOS |Vth| is about 1 V. Current budget: IREF 10 uA plus a 56 uA tail gives about 119 uW. Small caps and an R1=2*R2 split keep the OTA load and feedthrough small."}

PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (18.0, 12.0, 22.0),     # input pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (0.5, 0.25, 1.0),       # input pair L
    "I1":    (28e-6, 15e-6, 32e-6),  # current per input device (tail = 2*I1)
    "gmidp": (10.0, 7.0, 13.0),      # PMOS mirror load gm/Id
    "Lp":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),        # PMOS load L
    "C2":    (0.4e-12, 0.25e-12, 1.0e-12),  # SK grounded cap
    "q":     (0.68, 0.60, 0.72),     # design Q (below 0.707 to absorb finite-GBW Q boost)
    "rr":    (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),        # R1/R2 ratio (big R1 -> less output feedthrough)
    "fct":   (1.5e6, 1.44e6, 1.56e6) # target -3 dB frequency
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-12)
    I1 = p["I1"]

    # ---------------- OTA (NMOS-input 5T, unity-gain follower) ----------------
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=0.45, vsb=0.3)   # input pair
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I1, vds=0.9)             # PMOS mirror load
    mt = lut.size("n", 10.0, 1.0, 2 * I1, vds=0.3)                   # tail
    mb = lut.size("n", 10.0, 1.0, iref, vds=0.6)                     # ibias diode (ref)

    gm1 = m1.gm
    rout = 1.0 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    A0 = gm1 * rout

    # ---------------- Sallen-Key unity gain sizing ----------------
    q = p["q"]; r = p["rr"]
    C2 = p["C2"]
    n_c = q * q * (1 + r) ** 2 / r          # C1/C2 for desired Q with R1 = r*R2
    C1 = n_c * C2
    # -3 dB to f0 ratio for 2nd-order lowpass
    a = 1 - 1 / (2 * q * q)
    kfc = math.sqrt(a + math.sqrt(a * a + 1))
    f0 = p["fct"] / kfc
    w0 = 2 * PI * f0
    c2_par = 0.3 * m1.cgg                   # partially bootstrapped gate cap of M1
    C2_place = max(C2 - c2_par, 0.1e-12)
    # w0 = 1/sqrt(R1 R2 C1 C2) = 1/(R2 sqrt(r C1 C2))
    R2 = 1.0 / (w0 * math.sqrt(r * C1 * C2))
    R1 = r * R2

    # ---------------- Netlist ----------------
    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    # bias
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    # input pair: M1 (+) at SK node x, M2 (-) tied to vout
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "x", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "vout", "vout", "tail", "vss", m1)
    # PMOS mirror load (diode on M1 side -> M1 gate non-inverting)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "vout", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    # Sallen-Key network
    n.R("R1", "vin", "n1", R1)
    n.R("R2", "n1", "x", R2)
    n.C("C1", "n1", "vout", C1)
    n.C("C2", "x", "vss", C2_place)

    # ---------------- Predictions ----------------
    cout = cl + C1 + m3.cdd + m1.cdd + m1.cgd
    gbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * cout)
    q_eff = q * (1 + 2 * q * f0 / gbw * 0.5)     # rough finite-GBW Q boost
    if q_eff > 1 / math.sqrt(2):
        pk = 20 * math.log10(q_eff / math.sqrt(1 - 1 / (4 * q_eff ** 2)))
    else:
        pk = 0.0
    fc = p["fct"]
    x = 10 * fc / f0
    h = 1 / math.sqrt((1 - x * x) ** 2 + (x / q) ** 2)
    # extra OTA pole helps; feedthrough via R1 into closed-loop output impedance hurts
    zout = 1 / (2 * PI * 10 * fc * cout)
    ff = zout / R1
    atten = -20 * math.log10(h + ff)
    gain_db = 20 * math.log10(A0 / (1 + A0))
    power = 1.8 * (iref + 2 * I1)

    return n, {"fc": fc, "atten_db": atten, "peaking_db": pk,
               "power": power, "gain_db": gain_db}
